Strategy: Extend the winning band with a penalty for very loose leftovers above sixty, so placements avoid leaving oversized remainders. It may help by keeping leftovers in the useful range, but may fail by punishing bins that later large items need.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if r - item >= 28 and r - item <= 42 else 0) - (25 if r - item >= 6 and r - item <= 20 else 0) - (25 if r - item > 60 else 0) for r in bins]
```
